_purpose: Ordered backlog of chapters that already have an old-style lib/*Source.ts file wired in, but still need to be REGENERATED FROM SCRATCH to match docs/bible-study-note-style.md (the new hand-written style spec adopted 2026-07-31). The hourly Bible Note Writer Agent routine must treat the FIRST entry in this list as the next chapter to write, even though a file already exists for it -- overwrite it, do not skip it. Remove the entry (pop from the front) only after that chapter's regenerated file has passed the style checker, parser check, and tsc, and has been committed and pushed. Once this array is empty, fall back to normal forward-progress logic (first chapter in canonical order with no existing wired-in file).
styleCheckerScript: python3 scripts/check_bible_note_style.py lib/<file>Source.ts -- run this before finishing every chapter and fix everything it reports (it exits 0 clean, 1 if problems found). It catches the mechanical rules (line length, exactly 4 bullets, banned words/punctuation, repeated emoji, duplicate titles) but cannot judge whether a note actually teaches something instead of reciting the verse -- still apply the full checklist in docs/bible-study-note-style.md section 13 by eye too.
